info.title: Expedite Partners API
info.description: Approved partners invite founders to complete a Delaware C Corporation in Expedite, track incorporation progress, and receive signed updates. Document access requires the founder's separate permission.

post.description: Expedite POSTs to your verified endpoint when referral progress changes, including verified EIN issuance. Fetch GET /incorporations/{referralId} with your API token to read current authorized state. The callback contains no EIN number or document. Delivery is at least once and can arrive out of order; deduplicate by event ID and compare referral versions.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: Event ID. Match it to the signed body and deduplicate by this value across retries.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Delivery timestamp in Unix seconds. Reject timestamps outside a five-minute tolerance.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: "v1," followed by the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of webhook-id + "." + webhook-timestamp + "." + the exact raw body. Use the issued signing secret as the UTF-8 key and compare in constant time before parsing.

2XX.description: Event acknowledged. No response body is required.

post.description: Expedite sends this signed event when you request endpoint verification. Verify the signature and return 2xx to activate delivery. This event has no referral ID and is not an incorporation update.
